title: Mobile Suit Gundam Side Story II: Ao o Uketsugu Mono
native_title: 機動戦士ガンダム外伝Ⅱ ～蒼を受け継ぐ者～
overview:
The One Year War, U.C. 0079. As Earth Federation mobile suit pilot Yuu Kajima, you are now the pilot of "Blue" - the RX-79BD GM Blue Destiny, an experimental machine fitted with the mysterious EXAM System. As the tests continue, another blue shadow closes in: the Zeon Ifrit Kai, carrying an EXAM System of its own.

The second chapter of a three-part story, this 3D shooting game puts you in the cockpit for five missions to destroy targets, defend positions and escort allies. Each mission is graded, and top marks earn promotions. Your service record from the first chapter carries over through saved data and can affect how your story unfolds, though this chapter can also be played on its own.

- First-person cockpit view of 3D battlefields
- Twin Stick compatible
- Memory backup support
